en.title: Equities reprice sharply as Treasuries absorb the shock and credit risk begins to widen
en.deck: The 20 November sell-off was not a uniform flight to cash: equities and precious metals fell, oil rose on geopolitical risk, the dollar barely moved and Treasury yields dropped. The next test is whether repricing reaches funding markets.
en.regime: Cross-asset risk repricing with restrictive monetary conditions
en.key_risk: An equity valuation correction could migrate into non-bank liquidity, collateral and credit funding if spreads and redemption pressure continue to rise.
en.search_text: Global Macro 21 November 2026; global equity sell-off; US Treasury yields; high-yield credit spreads; non-bank financial institutions; private credit; capital flows; oil and geopolitical risk.

pt-BR.title: Bolsas reprecificam o risco, Treasuries absorvem o choque e o crédito começa a abrir
pt-BR.deck: A venda de 20 de novembro não foi uma fuga uniforme para o caixa: ações e metais preciosos recuaram, petróleo subiu com o risco geopolítico, o dólar quase não mudou e os rendimentos dos Treasuries caíram. O próximo teste é a transmissão para o financiamento.
pt-BR.regime: Reprecificação transversal de risco sob condições monetárias restritivas
pt-BR.key_risk: Uma correção das avaliações acionárias pode alcançar a liquidez de instituições não bancárias, as garantias e o financiamento de crédito se spreads e resgates continuarem aumentando.

signal_rationale.delta: The 20 November cross-asset pattern shows a broad equity decline alongside a Treasury rally, a flat dollar, falling gold and copper, and rising oil; the next analytical question is whether the repricing migrates into credit funding.
signal_rationale.evidence: Reuters market close data; US Treasury par curve; FRED high-yield spread through 19 November; ECB Financial Stability Review of November 2026; September Treasury TIC flows.
signal_rationale.scale_path: Equity valuation losses can affect non-bank fund liquidity, repo collateral, redemptions and bank/non-bank funding links if volatility persists.
signal_rationale.transmission: The immediate price shock is concentrated in equities, while sovereign duration remains a hedge; credit spreads, repo terms and redemption restrictions are the observable next channels.
signal_rationale.falsifier: Rapid equity recovery, volatility normalization and stable or narrowing credit spreads without new redemption restrictions would weaken the interpretation of a broader repricing cycle.

key_constraints: The 20 November market close is the latest full global session; 21 November is a Saturday.
The US high-yield spread is available through 19 November only at the information cutoff.
Treasury TIC flows are for September and cannot establish November portfolio flows.
The B3 was closed on 20 November; no Brazilian equity close is reported for that date.
The oil-price move reflects a reported geopolitical risk premium; no new attack is inferred from prices.

producer_checks.novelty_decision: Distinct from the three latest editions: focuses on cross-asset transmission and funding channels after the 20 November equity sell-off, rather than another semiconductor valuation, European inflation or energy-supply report.
limitations: No same-day 20 November high-yield spread was available at cutoff.
No reliable same-day global fund-flow series was available.
TIC data are one month lagged and custody-based.
The market attribution for oil reflects Reuters reporting and is not evidence of a new attack.
